executiveSummary: During this monthly monitoring cycle, we reviewed App and Dashboard server performance, cleared stale build cache on both environments, and identified and resolved an SMTP email delivery issue on the Dashboard. Both servers remained stable throughout the monitoring period.

themeUpdateLog.summary: Shopify pushed platform updates to its free theme library this cycle. We tracked every release that touched a theme in scope for this store.
themeUpdateLog.testedNote: Dawn and Crave (v16.0.0) are the two themes this store actually uses, so we selected them for full Tree Contribution Widget compatibility and multi-device responsive testing — results on the following pages.

incidents.title: SMTP Email Delivery Issue — Dashboard
incidents.issue: During the monitoring period, the Dashboard server reported an HTTP 500 error on the email template test endpoint.
incidents.rootCause: Gmail SMTP authentication rejected the previously configured credentials with the error: EAUTH 535 — Username and Password not accepted.
resolutionSteps: The client provided the correct SMTP credentials, which were updated in the Heroku configuration.
SMTP authentication completed successfully with no further errors observed during verification.
incidents.conclusion: SMTP configuration was successfully updated and email delivery functionality was restored and verified.
